title: Copy shader orbs into the project

orbs.description: Comma-separated orb slugs (orb-01 … orb-33, or just the number), or "all".

project.description: The application project to copy into. Defaults to the first application in angular.json.

force.description: Overwrite orbs that already exist in the project.

list.description: Print the available orbs and exit without copying anything.
